note: The harness and gbrain releases internal-task-a's pilot and counted runs use: the newest release of each on 2026-11-19 (Hermes: its newest tag; gbrain: moved on 2026-11-22 to the newest release on master, v0.60.763.0 from 12:32Z). scripts/frontier-harbor/pin.json is internal-task-b's and stays unchanged; agents.py and run.ts read this file for any version pin.json does not pin. agents.py checks every frozen install inside the trial container (HE-MCP-050 on a mismatch). Models pin.json does not list are in "models", in pin.json's model entry shape; agents.py and run.ts read them only for a model pin.json lacks (R116, 2026-11-21: older-generation models are suspended, so the codex cells run openai:gpt-6.2-sol, whose id, window and output limit are from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.2-sol, read 2026-11-21).

claude-code.install: Harbor ClaudeCode.install (bootstrap.sh 2.1.328, the native binary); agents.py requires the installed binary's sha256 to equal native_binary_sha256 (the linux-x64 checksum in the release manifest)

codex.install: Harbor Codex.install (npm install -g @openai/codex@0.170.0); agents.py requires codex --version to say 0.170.0

hermes.install: pin.json's own entry (the newest tag on 2026-11-19 is the pinned one); FrontierHermes checks the commit and the anthropic SDK

openclaw.install: FrontierOpenClaw (Harbor OpenClaw.install on Node 24, npm install -g openclaw@2026.11.5); agents.py requires openclaw --version to name 2026.11.5

pi.install: Harbor Pi.install (npm install -g --ignore-scripts @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.5.2); agents.py requires pi --version to say 1.5.2

gbrain.install: gbrain.ts writeGbrainImage (bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.763.0 in the gbrain task image); run.ts refuses an image whose release is not this tag and commit
